Offshore Fish Report for 11-22-2026

Sunday Recap

  • Offshore
  • Pacific Bluefin Tuna
  • Nov 22, 2026

Sunday Recap

11-22-2026
by Seaforth Staff
(619) 224-3383
Website

Sunday Returning Trips

  • The Tribute on their 1.5 day returned with 44 Skipjack Tuna
  • The Aztec returned from a 1.5 day charter with 35 Yellowtail, 4 Yellowfin Tuna, 1 Dorado, 1 Barracuda, and 10 Calico Bass.

San Diego Full Day

  • The San Diego on their full day had an action packed day reporting 205 Yellowfin Tuna, and 185 Skipjack Tuna! We added the December schedule for the San Diego, so keep the gear ready for some holiday fishing!

Sea Watch 1/2 Day

  • The Sea Watch was back on the Tuna today on both AM and PM half day trips landing over 100+ Yellowfin! A 25lb flyline outfit has been recommended with size 2 and 4 hooks. Come on down for some fun fall fishing!
